bluf: Novicell is a Danish digital consultancy out of Højbjerg (Aarhus) and London, technology independent by its own description, 20+ years old with 300+ experts claimed, building web and commerce platforms for mid market clients on Umbraco, Sitecore and Dynamicweb. Its AI moves are public: an AI services pillar, an AI SEO and GEO page, ChatGPT Ads offered from August 2026, and 24+ LinkedIn ads promoting a Copenhagen Composable Conference on 30 Oct 2026 and talks on AI agents writing code. A rival should know that 32 of its 35 named clients carry no described work and that it sells AI visibility with no llms.txt on its own house.
doing:
Novicell positions as an international, technology independent digital consultancy with 20+ years' experience, combining business development, technology, UX and marketing across web, commerce, data and hosting: it builds and hosts web and commerce platforms and adds marketing, data and CRM work around them. The headline claim is 20+ years and a team of 300+ experts.

The sold mix leads with web and product, scored 3: the services index opens with software development and IT architecture, and most cases are web and commerce platform builds. Six core lines score 2. AI Automation rests on a homepage CTA to AI services, an AI pillar and LinkedIn ads on AI agents writing code. AI Search / GEO rests on a dedicated AI SEO and GEO page and a ChatGPT Ads page. Data & Measurement rests on the Data Value line, Novicell Insights and Commerce BI, and the Molslinjen data warehouse case. Email & CRM rests on a CRM & Martech page (CRM, CDP, marketing automation) and the Molslinjen automation engine case. Paid Search rests on Google Ads under Digital Advertising and the Proshop Google Shopping and Summerbird PPC cases. SEO rests on international, strategy and on page pages and the Excedo global visibility and Dol-Sensors SEO site cases. Creator, local and retail media score 0. Partners: Umbraco partner and Dynamicweb certified partner. Proprietary lines: Spark Accelerator, Novicell Insights, Novicell Commerce BI.

Its AI posture is an AI services pillar, AI SEO and GEO and ChatGPT Ads, with LinkedIn ads featuring talks on AI agents writing code under human direction. The one dated move is August 2026: it began offering ChatGPT Ads to clients as the channel launched in Denmark and 30 European markets. The record lists no news, case study text, jobs or pricing signals. Conspicuously absent for a consultancy of its size: ownership, a founding year, any pricing, an llms.txt, and a readable Google ads record (the lookup was blocked).
clients:
The client type is mid market and the verticals run wide: retail and brands, law firms and professional services, manufacturing, pharma, insurance, energy and broadband, wholesale, travel and leisure, member organisations, public organisations and transportation. Home markets are Denmark (Højbjerg, Aarhus) and the UK (London, Shoreditch), the two offices listed.

The needs read holds 35 clients, 3 with an observed need and 32 named only, from 31 case studies and 4 slugs. The 3 observed are Plantorama, Egmont and Dansk Erhverv, coded local and lead generation on the dk cases signal alone. The rest are named only, though the capability notes describe work for some: Skechers came for a Nordic webshop (web build), Umbraco for its marketing site (web build), Molslinjen for a data warehouse and an automation engine (data and measurement, CRM), Proshop for Google Shopping and Summerbird for PPC (paid performance), and Dol-Sensors for an SEO site (organic demand). The named only roster includes Revlon, The British Library, Geberit, AlixPartners, Salling, GF Forsikring, Carletti, DESMI, The Army Painter, Pressalit, Red Cross, Korea Tourism Organisation, Roskilde Festival, Skagenfood, Socialdemokratiet, 7IM, The Property Ombudsman and VVSPlus, with Reed Smith, Hill Dickinson, JYSK and Kamstrup as slugs; their needs are inferred from the web build lead. No client is shared with another tracked agency.

What the base needs next: a platform build book sits under KJ1 (the click is being replaced by the citation), its Horus tailwind, and KJ5 (the price of attention splits in two), its headwind. It is very likely, moderate confidence, that these commerce and public sector clients will ask for the machine readable layer (feeds, schema, entities) on the platforms it built, and likely, moderate confidence, that they will ask for an audited AI visibility number the record does not yet show.
house: Say and do: two lines tested, one practised, integrity 50. AI search is contradicted: it sells AI visibility and publishes no llms.txt, with 4 AI topic URLs in a 1229 URL sitemap. Publishing cadence: 1 sitemap URL updated in 90 days and 10 in 365, slow for a site that size. Paid search is unknown because the Transparency Center lookup was blocked. LinkedIn was not tested but the record shows 24+ company page ads, a floor: one announces the first speakers for the Copenhagen Composable Conference on 30 October 2026, one says most retail companies have mapped the customer journey but few use it to manage, and one asks what happens when AI agents build the code and people set the direction, fronted by Lukas Jankauskas, AI enablement. The tag stack is GTM and HubSpot on Nuxt, Umbraco and Sitecore; no social pixels, test tools or ABM stack. It blocks no AI crawlers.
market:
Horus puts Novicell at tailwind index 16.6, band Favored, 16:39 on the Solar Arc. Best placed for KJ1 (the click replaced by the citation, driven by AI Search / GEO). Most exposed to KJ5 (the price of attention splits in two, driven by Paid Social and Programmatic & CTV), a mild headwind. Best scenario fit: The Bazaar of Agents at 40/100. It is making P2 (feeds, schema or entity work alongside a core line), P4 (supplying the inputs automation runs on) and P8 (ads inside assistants with holdout or incrementality measurement), partial on P1, P6 and P7; P3 does not apply and P5 is unknown.

The Monsoon read is 57.8, band Onshore wind, percentile 60: migration 55.3 against displacement 60.3. The sold mix supplies 55 of the index, Web & Product (14) and SEO (9) carrying the most movable hours; the work would go 50% to South and Southeast Asia and 40% to Eastern Europe. The footprint is inferred: no hub offices, no onshore claims, mid market client type adding 5 points.
openings:
The strongest opening is the book: 32 of 35 named clients carry no described work, and the three observed needs rest on a dk cases signal alone, so a rival can very likely (moderate confidence) contest any of the named accounts by asking what Novicell did and when, since the public record cannot say. Falsifier: a later compile in which the case pages, modified through August 2026, yield described work and need codes for most of the roster would close it.

Lead with the AI visibility contradiction: it sells AI SEO and GEO with benchmarking and measurement on the page and publishes no llms.txt on its own house (P1 partial, no audited product on record), so a rival with a citation share number and its own house in order leads with both. Displacement 60.3 on an Onshore wind read says price is a live lever for the web and SEO hours, so an offshore delivered build and SEO offer undercuts the platform retainers, and no public pricing (P5 unknown) leaves an outcome priced offer unanswered. Its exposure to KJ5 is mild; the contest is on proof and price, not on the market turning against its mix.
watch: I2, Alphabet Q3 2026 search growth and AI Mode ad disclosures, late October 2026: growth below 10% flags cannibalization, above 15% with AI Mode ads live confirms S1 and the KJ1 tailwind its AI SEO and GEO page sells into.
I10, Reddit US daily users against search referral volatility, late October 2026: US DAUq growth at or below 5% alongside AI Mode growth confirms the UGC starvation risk under KJ1.

I3, OpenAI ad run rate disclosures and CPM trend, rolling: the $2B milestone and pricing below $20 CPM decide whether the ChatGPT Ads it began offering in August 2026 become a priced channel it can prove (P8 making).

I1, Comscore monthly AI prompt share, next in the Comscore Q3 report expected around December 2026: Gemini at or above 40% or ChatGPT at or below 45% favors S1, no assistant above 50% with Claude and Perplexity rising favors S2, and bears on KJ3.
The Copenhagen Composable Conference on 30 October 2026, promoted in 24+ LinkedIn ads: who speaks and which clients appear on stage is the next client evidence the record can add.
